requirements.condition: When deploying servers that receive new connections.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit an attacker's ability to target a new connection to a particular server instance.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not allow an attacker unrestricted ability to direct a new connection to a particular server instance.
requirements.why_checkable: A deployment's connection-routing behavior can be tested to determine whether attacker-controlled inputs enable selection of a particular server instance.

requirements.condition: When routing a new connection to a server instance.
requirements.required_behavior: Make routing decisions independently of client-selected values, including addresses.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not base server-instance routing decisions on client-selected values, including addresses.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can vary client-selected values and addresses and observe whether they influence the selected server instance, but the word “Ideally” makes this guidance nonbinding.
